newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Algerie starts flights to Mali, Niger.
newsitem.headline: Air Algerie starts flights to Mali, Niger.

text.p: Air Algerie, the state carrier, on Thursday began operating flights to Gao and Agadez in Mali and Niger respectively, Algerian state-run radio said.

Transport Minister Essaid Bendakir and Air Algerie managing director Faisal Khalil inaugurated the flights, along with Mali and Niger transport officials, linking the southern Algerian town of Tamanrasset to Gao and Agadez to the south, it said.
"Expanding air links with Mali and Niger reflect the interests of the Algerian authorities to boost cooperation with Algeria's southern neighbouring countries," Bendakir told the radio.
Air Algerie already flies to Bamako and Niamey.
